title: Doctor Fletcher
summary: Raleigh names Doctor Fletcher in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Doctor Fletcher, whose discourse of the Russe Common-wealth tells how the returning Scythians, or Sarmatians, recouered their homes from their bondslaues. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
